file_roles.evidence: The validator re-parsed stored metadata with the default kind, which is the user-facing one, 'Status CollectionOptions::validate() const { return CollectionOptions().parse(toBSON()); }'. The fix passes the kind that accepts a server-generated UUID, 'Status CollectionOptions::validateForStorage() const { return CollectionOptions().parse(toBSON(), ParseKind::parseForStorage); }'. The parse function itself is unchanged below, 'Status CollectionOptions::parse(const BSONObj& options, ParseKind kind) { *this = {};'.

Declaration only: 'Status validate() const;' becomes 'Status validateForStorage() const;', with the neighbouring 'Status parse(const BSONObj& obj, ParseKind kind = parseForCommand);' and the 'enum ParseKind { parseForCommand, parseForStorage };' untouched. The stale comment above it, 'Confirms that collection options can be converted to BSON and back without errors.', is not even updated.

One call site following the rename, 'uassertStatusOK(options.validate());' becoming 'uassertStatusOK(options.validateForStorage());', in the middle of untouched constructor checks such as 'uassert(ErrorCodes::BadValue, "callback function cannot be null", onCompletion);'.

rationale: The report states the failing function and the mechanism directly, 'Currently, validate() will fail if the metadata contains a collection UUID' and 'This behavior is controlled by the CollectionOptions::ParseKind enumeration when calling CollectionOptions::parse()'. The diff corrects exactly that: the omitted second argument defaulted to parseForCommand, which rejects a UUID, so the defect and the place it surfaced are the same two-line body. The other two gold files carry the rename outward and change no behaviour.
notes: REPORT-NAMES-FIX: the report names the faulty function and prescribes the mechanism of the adopted fix. It also names the change that introduced the defect rather than a location, 'CollectionOptions started supporting an optional collection UUID in SERVER-27987', which is the ticket-level analogue of a bisect result. The instance has no failure output: there is no log, no trace and no reproducer, only prose, so log_location.determinable = false. Gold composition is the point here: of three gold files one holds the corrected logic and two are a declaration rename and a single call site, both pure call-site adaptation per the convention. The fix changed 6 files and only 3 are non-test source, so 3 test files were filtered as intended.
